family.sign_pin: REGISTERED: PC signs pinned to the frozen vec2 plane. Bounds are invariant to PC sign; a trained circuit is not.
family.normalisation: REGISTERED: p_k(r) = PC_k(r) / max_{r' in HUMANS} |PC_k(r')| for k = 1, 2. Divisors: PC1 8.669495, PC2 10.160404

plane_agreement_with_frozen2d.verdict: the frozen 2D embeddings ARE the unit-normalised raw PCA plane; FA's angle and the raw-PCA angle are the SAME quantity

radial_coordinate.note: this is exactly the information unit-normalisation destroyed. F2-raw = (PC1, PC2) = (rho cos phi, rho sin phi) carries angle AND radius; FA carries angle only. That is why exp68 on this family is width-as-INFORMATION, not width-as-reparameterisation.

feature_formulas.F1: F1: PC1 only, p = p1; theta = (p + 1) * pi        -> [0, 2pi); u = (1, cos theta, sin theta). d = 3.
feature_formulas.F2: F2: two-qubit register, theta0 = SCALE(PC1) on qubit 0, theta1 = SCALE(PC2) on qubit 1, both by theta = (p + 1) * pi        -> [0, 2pi); u = vec(u(theta0) (x) u(theta1)). d = 9.
feature_formulas.FA: FA: phi = atan2(p2, p1); u = (1, cos phi, sin phi). d = 3. The EXISTING single-angle map (exp42 intro_convention, angle = atan2(y, x)); scaling-free.

bound_definition.quantity: PER-TWIN reachable accuracy, doc 47 SS17: the two twins of a cast are SEPARATE constraints on a GENERAL C, so a cast may score 0, 1/2 or 1. Denominator = 2|B||N|.
bound_definition.identity_used: argmax over M = 2 outcomes is sign(<V_0 - V_1, phi>) with V_0 - V_1 unrestricted, so the M = 2 cell of the readout-arity calculus IS the per-twin general-C MAX-FS. That identity is why the stronger search applies to a quantity two committed files carry.
bound_definition.seeding: the committed per-twin witness is handed to the search as a seed, so the returned value is >= the committed value BY CONSTRUCTION and a 'supersedes' verdict can never be a search artefact in the wrong direction

F1.definition: F1: PC1 only, p = p1; theta = (p + 1) * pi        -> [0, 2pi); u = (1, cos theta, sin theta). d = 3.
F1.method: CONSTRUCTIVE LOWER BOUND (same three-stage search as readout_arity_bounds.py: annealed logsumexp surrogate, latent multiclass hinge over a 4-margin ladder, hard-count polish, plus basin hops; SEEDED with the committed per-twin witness, so it can never return less than the committed value)

strict_margin_certification.note: a counted-correct twin must beat every wrong-class outcome STRICTLY; an exact tie would be an argmax tie-break banked as a win, which is doc 47 SS16's defect class

F2.definition: F2: two-qubit register, theta0 = SCALE(PC1) on qubit 0, theta1 = SCALE(PC2) on qubit 1, both by theta = (p + 1) * pi        -> [0, 2pi); u = vec(u(theta0) (x) u(theta1)). d = 9.
